title: Cache Body arc-length prefix data for vertex appearance sampling
description: Performance follow-up under TSK-0008. BodyVerticalGradientSampler finds the closest Body segment per vertex in O(segmentCount), then recomputes the prefix sum of prior segment lengths in a second O(segmentCount) loop to obtain the body-length parameter. The frames are now reused correctly, but the arc-length lookup remains avoidable repeated work. Add authoritative cumulative segment-length data to the resolved Body snapshot and replace the per-vertex prefix walk with indexed lookup/interpolation. Preserve the existing closest-segment projection, head/tail orientation convention, exact gradient coordinates, and degenerate-body behavior; validate appearance parity before benchmarking.
